emergency_key_notice: Important: Save your Emergency Recovery Key safely to regain access if you forget your PIN.
stage_1_desc: Authentication, PostgreSQL-ready database engine, multi-tenancy, and currency formatting are active.
onboarding_subtitle: Tell us how your business runs so Kanakku can tailor its screens, speed, and tools to you.
onboarding_banner_desc: Configure your operations to unlock the exact Kanakku interface tailored to your complexity.
step1_desc: What is the official name and nature of your business?
step2_desc: Employee count alone does not complicate software. How many total workers do you have, and how many will use Kanakku?
hint_workforce: Includes cooks, drivers, tailors, delivery agents, and helpers.
hint_app_users: Staff who operate this counter, create bills, or check reports.
step3_desc: How many retail counters or warehouse storage facilities do you operate?
step4_desc: Which operations describe what you do? (Select all that apply)
step5_desc: Do you need to keep real-time stock balances and track supplier purchase orders?
label_tracks_inventory: Do you track product stock counts?
yes_tracks_inventory: Yes, track daily stock levels and low-stock alerts
no_tracks_inventory: No, pure service / fast billing without stock counts
label_purchase_orders: Do you issue formal Purchase Orders to suppliers?
yes_purchase_orders: Yes, generate Purchase Orders and verify Goods Received
no_purchase_orders: No, purchase bills recorded directly when goods arrive
step6_desc: Do you transform raw materials into finished products or manage batch expiry dates?
step7_desc: Do you extend credit (Udhar) to trusted customers, or need to manage supplier payables?
hint_customer_credit: Record customer balances, send WhatsApp payment reminders, and set credit limits.
hint_supplier_payments: Keep an exact record of how much money you owe to each vendor.
step8_desc: Do you need staff permission boundaries and manager approval rules?
hint_staff_permissions: Prevent cashiers from seeing profit margins or discount limits.
label_approval_workflows: Require manager approval for bill cancellations or high discounts?
step9_desc: In which language do you and your team prefer to use Kanakku?
lang_tanglish: Tanglish — Tamil in English script (e.g., 'Bill Podunga')
step10_desc: Adjust interface typography and touch targets for comfort and rapid billing.
label_high_contrast: High Contrast Mode (Sleek dark borders, maximum sunlight visibility)
label_large_font: Extra Large Fonts & 54px Touch Buttons (Ergonomic for fast fingers)
label_simplified_ui: Minimalist Counter Screen (Hide non-essential buttons during rush hours)
review_desc: Verify your operational answers before generating your tailored recommendation.
recommendation_desc: Based on your operational complexity, our deterministic rule engine recommends:
tier_simple_desc: Tailored for small shops and single counters. High speed, big buttons, clean screens, zero unnecessary complexity.
tier_growth_desc: Ideal for expanding retailers, wholesalers, and small manufacturers. Moving average costing, credit ledgers, and POs.
tier_enterprise_desc: Engineered for complex multi-location networks, production BOMs, strict audit trails, and multi-tier approval workflows.
owner_choice_prompt: You are in control. Select your preferred tier:
toggle_module_hint: You can toggle individual modules on or off at any time in Settings.
completion_desc: Your workspace has been customized for {tier}. You can revisit preferences anytime in Settings.
profile_settings_desc: View and update your operational configuration, active tier, and enabled modules.
